items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The old man, he was a good musician on the trombone and the articulation, boys followed him and his style

ctx.x: Let's talk a bit more, Mr. Blakeney, about William Woodman, the father of Coney and Britt Woodman.
was a good musician on the trombone and the articulation, boys followed him and his style, on the trombone. He made a lot of fast passages on the trombone; he was famous for that.
